response.original_title: a pure person, as time goes by
response.overview: In an industrial corner and along a quiet canal, a drifting boy and a wistful girl  navigate the blurred lines between memory and imagination — as he redefines  himself in solitude, and she recalls her past memories of youth and friendship.  To explore what it means to begin again; together forming a fragmented  aftertaste of youth, identity, and the people who once stayed.
